name: Three studies of Chinese figures, Macau
summary:
The sketches depict (LR) two blacksmiths with raised hammers and cylindrical bellows, inscribed in the artist's shorthand 'excellent picture at any time'; 
(CL, inverted) a figure holding up a parasol, inscribed faintly in shorthand to the figure's left 'the front of the basket...head by a cloth',

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
